description: Profils en long des fossés et évacuation des eaux pluviales du lotissement Couachi de Mana (1999) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.guyane-sig.fr. Scanned map of profiles along the ditches and drainage of rainwater from the Couachi subdivision of the municipality of Mana. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Profiles along the ditches and stormwater drainage of the Couachi de Mana subdivision (1999)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include eau pluviale, mana, 1999, guyane. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
